sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your counter-offer and are willing to commit to a 24-month contract to ensure long-term stability for both sides.

Our personal commitment to high quality has defined our family foundry for generations, and we value our shared relationship. For our current proposition, we present a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

However, as a medium-sized family business, we cannot accommodate 60-day payment terms and must insist on our standard 30 days. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to do business with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, given the long relationship our foundry has shared with your respected company over the years. Our team takes great pride in the quality of the work we deliver from our region.

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We have already made a significant step towards you by offering €52.20 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

We must therefore maintain our current offer and ask you to reconsider your position. We hope you understand our situation and look forward to continuing our trustful partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to deal with our valued partners, and our long relationship means a great deal to our family foundry. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Please understand that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We have already accommodated your request for 60-day payment terms and a 24-month contract at €52.20. Therefore, our current offer remains a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We must maintain our offer and ask you to return to a constructive approach so that we may continue our work together in the best tradition of our region.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
